## Contributor checklist (DCO required)

The project uses the **Developer Certificate of Origin 1.1 (DCO)**.
A GitHub bot checks every PR; commits without a `Signed-off-by:` line
will block the merge.

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] I have read [LICENSE](../blob/main/LICENSE) (PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0)
- [ ] All my commits include a `Signed-off-by:` line
      (added with `git commit -s` or by amending)
- [ ] I understand my contribution is licensed under the same terms as
      the project
- [ ] I understand the **Inbound=Outbound clause** in CONTRIBUTING.md:
      the maintainer may relicense my contribution under any license
      terms, current or future, while I retain ownership and the right
      to use my own code independently
- [ ] I am the original author of the contribution, OR I have the
      right to submit it under the project's license (per the DCO)

## Checklist (please tick)

- [ ] My code follows the project's style (PEP 8, type hints,
      single-blank-line import groups, ~100 char line length)
- [ ] I have not modified `core_pipeline/` (if I have, I opened an
      issue first and linked it above)
- [ ] I have not modified the 5 settings tabs (AI, Usage, Appearance,
      Files, Behavior) or the About tab without prior discussion
- [ ] My changes don't break existing user data
      (or I've called out the migration steps in the description)
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation (README, CHANGES doc, etc.)
